semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical temperature control systems used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Advanced Thermal Sciences Taiwan Corp. manufactures heat exchange chillers and temperature control systems for the semiconductor industry, ensuring precise temperature management crucial for wafer manufacturing. Their products are integrated into main etcher systems from major manufacturers, highlighting their importance in semiconductor fabrication.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company operates in Taiwan, focusing on manufacturing and supporting temperature control systems for the semiconductor industry.
